text:
IncidentsBot: Pager: elevated 5xx/timeouts on /v1/generate (us-west1) — error-rate 5m avg 18% -> paging oncall

Samir: Ack. @Ryan oncall — are you able to take?

Ryan (oncall): I’m here, paging in. Pulling up dashboards.

Olivia: seeing queue backlog in batcher shards: total queued requests ~18,200 (5m), inflight unchanged. p95 latency up to 2.7s, p99 spills to 8s. 502s and upstream timeouts in gateway logs.

Maria: sounds like head-of-line. batcher scheduler appears to be stuck on a few huge batches — batch-size spikes from normal 16->512 for some clients. KV cache growth also high on a few nodes.

Ashley: can we identify which tenants sent the huge batches? run: `select tenant, count(*) from requests where batch_size>256 group by tenant`

Olivia: ran that, top offenders: acct-acme (42%), acct-orbit (18%), unknown-service-guest (12%). Also a spike of long-running 1.2s token streams that keep the slot.

Ryan (oncall): ok — plan: 1) throttle very large batches at gateway for 60s 2) reroute traffic off the hot batcher shards to us-west2 as a relief 3) enable small-model fallback for timeout-prone routes. Anyone object?

Samir: +1. We should also limit max_batch_size to 128 at gateway for the affected tenants.

Olivia: I'll push the gateway rule: `gatewayctl apply -f - <<EOF
- match: path:/v1/generate tenant:acct-acme
  actions:
    - set-header: X-Max-Batch-Size=128
    - rate-limit: 200r/s
EOF`

Maria: I'll trigger a rebalance for batcher shards: `infra batcher rebalance --from us-west1-hot --to us-west2 --parallel=4 --drain=true` — this will move a few shards off the overloaded hosts. Expect temporary increased latency during handoff.

Ashley: Also queue eviction command available if rebalance stalls: `batcherctl evict --threshold=10000 --reason=gridlock` — last resort but helps free head-of-line.

Ryan (oncall): Execute the gateway rule now please. Olivia?

Olivia: Pushed the gateway rule. Confirmed via `gatewayctl get-rules` — active for acct-acme and acct-orbit.

Ryan (oncall): Starting rebalance. Kicking off `infra batcher rebalance` now. Watching metrics.

IncidentsBot: Action: `infra batcher rebalance` initiated by Maria at 3445678908 — estimated 90s per shard.

Olivia: within 30s of the rule, large-batch rate for acct-acme dropped 78%. error-rate started to fall — 5m avg down to 9%

Maria: first two shards drained, third is stuck (KV cache rebuild taking longer). I'm going to temporarily reduce `max_concurrent_kv_restore=2` on the node to prioritize serving.

Ashley: If KV restore is blocking, we can also evict the oldest caches for those tenants: `kvctl evict --tenant=acct-acme --cutoff=24h` — small risk of slightly higher tokenization cost but speeds recovery.

Ryan (oncall): Go ahead with eviction on stuck shard, Ashley.

Ashley: Eviction started. Logs: ```2026-03-15T14:15:02Z evict: tenant=acct-acme removed=31234 keys runtime=3.1s```

Olivia: error-rate now 4.2% (5m), p95 latency down to 1.1s. Gateway 502s reduced heavily.

Lee (CS): heads up — CS flagged 3 customers reporting timeouts (Acme, Orbit, Nova) and asked for ETA on full recovery. They're ready to send status updates once we have a mitigation timeline.

Samir: For customer comms: say "mitigation in progress, partial relief seen, expect progressive recovery over next 5-10 minutes, working on full drain and postmortem". Keep updates concise.

Ryan (oncall): Monitoring full drain. Also enabling fallback-simple-model for clients that accept lower quality but faster replies: `deploy-toggle model-fallback --service=generate --target=simple-128` for the tenant groups.

Maria: fallback toggled for the heavy tenants. We should see further reduction in resource pressure.

Olivia: metrics 60s after evict+rebalance: queued requests 2,100, error-rate 1.1%, lat p95 600ms.

Ryan (oncall): Good. Marking incident as mitigated but still monitoring. Can someone file an incident postmortem and capture timeline, tenant payload shapes, and suggested gateway hard-limits?

Ashley: I'll grab heap/profile from batcher nodes to see why huge batches were accepted — gateway rules should have prevented it, so maybe an old route bypassed the check.

Samir: Also add an automatic circuit-breaker that kicks in when batcher queued>8k to refuse new large batches.

Lee (CS): I'll notify the three impacted customers with a short update: "We saw elevated errors affecting generate in us-west1, mitigation applied and partial recovery in 10m — follow-up postmortem forthcoming".

IncidentsBot: Incident mitigated at 3445678915 by Ryan (oncall) — monitoring continues.

Ryan (oncall): Thanks team. Next steps: 1) Ashley + Olivia to root-cause why gateway rules weren't enforced for one route 2) Maria to document rebalance + eviction timeline and recommend autoscale knobs 3) Samir to draft postmortem and customer impact summary. I'll keep the channel open for 1 hour then archive thread.

Samir: noted. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:

Olivia: saving dashboards and query snippets to the incident runbook.

Ashley: uploading heap + logs to /incidents/3445678901/artifacts (link)

Lee (CS): I'll update customers after Samir's draft.

Ryan (oncall): Closing active pager; keeping channel soft-open for followups.
